timeline.text: Make it warmer. Make it more corporate. Everyone knows what they want, nobody can write it down.
So the picture came back wrong again, and someone tried again. Two hours of guessing per article.
Now nobody writes anything. You tap. Colour, mood, lighting, like ordering from a menu.
Forty-two options, and every tap is assembled into one instruction that Azure OpenAI can actually read.
Two hours of trial and error became fifteen minutes. Eighty-seven percent gone.
